text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Mile Championship, and powerful runners Biko Pegasus and Hishi Akebono will be running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki is feeling nervous, but the three of them wish each other a good race and do a pre-race ritual together to get ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her spirits lifted, Fuji Kiseki is ready for anything. The race begins.
